IC1: 1. Have dementia [OR] or delirium (as determined by the palliative care specialist) at study entry.
IC3: 3. Have been taking corticosteroids for longer than 48 hours.
IC4: 4. Have pulmonary edema [OR], ascites [OR] or pitting edema on clinical examination.
IC6: 6. Have a history of serious adverse gastrointestinal events [OR] (i.e., bleeding [OR] or perforation),history of a coagulopathy [OR] or current anti-coagulant use.
IC7: 7. Have an ALT/AST>3x upper limit of normal.
IC9: 9. Patients taking melatonin receptor agonists (such as Rozerem® [ramelteon]).
